name: print-social-11-11-fashion-sale-posts-with-doodle-lightning-and-serif-italics
title: 11.11 fashion sale pack with hand-drawn doodles, lightning bolts and italic serif headlines
whatItIs: Nine white square posts for an 11.11 'Price Drop' fashion sale: photos of a model in a brown coat, large mixed roman/italic serif headlines ('Dress to Impress with 11.11 Fashion Bliss!', 'Glam Up Your Life'), black outline doodles of hands, bursts and lightning bolts.
whatItMeans: Magazine serifs make a discount feel stylish; the scribbled doodles add energy and a zine-like wink.
techniques: Mix upright and italic serif within one headline for rhythm.
Scatter hand-drawn outline doodles around photos for energy.
Keep a white field so warm-toned photos carry the colour.
Repeat a tiny logo and date lockup in the same corner of every post.

vocabulary.definition: Hand-drawn marks layered over a clean layout.
A headline switching between roman and italic.
